_meta.description: Financial Health Score — composite 0-100 rating with weighted metrics and thresholds.
_meta.formula: FHS = Σ (metric_score × weight) where each metric_score is 0-100

interpretation.40-59: Needs Work — significant financial stress indicators

budget_adherence.description: How well actual spending matches budget targets across all variable categories.

green.label: On track
green.criteria: Total variable spend within 10% of targets

budget_adherence.data_source: financial-automation Budgets DB: compare Spent rollup vs Budget Amount

calculation_details.per_category_score: max(0, 100 - ((actual - target) / target × 100)) for each category
calculation_details.aggregate_score: weighted average of per-category scores, weighted by budget amount

emergency_fund_progress.description: Emergency fund balance as a percentage of the target (3 months essential expenses).
emergency_fund_progress.data_source: financial-automation Accounts DB: Emergency Savings balance

debt_to_income_ratio.description: Total monthly debt payments as a percentage of gross monthly income. Lower is better.

benchmarks.total_dti: All debt / gross income ≤ 36% ideal, 43% max QM
benchmarks.notes: Current estimated DTI of 42.3% is borderline — need actual data to confirm

savings_rate.description: Percentage of take-home pay directed to savings and investments (not debt payments).
excludes: Debt principal payments (those reduce debt, not savings)
savings_rate.data_source: investment_accounts.json contributions + Accounts DB savings growth

net_worth_trajectory.description: Month-over-month net worth change direction and magnitude.
net_worth_trajectory.formula: Score based on 3-month rolling average MoM change. Positive trend = higher score.

green.label: Growing
green.criteria: Net worth increasing ≥ $500/mo average over 3 months

net_worth_trajectory.data_source: Net Worth Snapshots Notion DB (created by this skill)

credit_utilization.description: Total credit card balances as a percentage of total credit limits. Measured at statement close.
credit_utilization.notes: Since all cards are paid in full monthly, utilization should always be green. Monitor statement close dates — high mid-cycle balance can still report to bureaus.
credit_utilization.optimization: If a large purchase spikes utilization, pay it down before statement close date.

rewards_efficiency.description: How well the household uses the optimal card for each purchase category.

green.label: Optimized
green.criteria: ≥ 85% of purchases on the optimal card

key_mistakes_to_detect: Dining on Amazon card instead of Sapphire Reserve
Amazon purchases on Freedom Unlimited instead of Amazon Prime card
Forgetting to activate Freedom Flex quarterly categories
Using Sapphire Reserve for non-bonus general spend
rewards_efficiency.data_source: Transaction categorization from financial-automation + chase_rewards.json optimal rules

format.per_metric_breakdown: table with score, weight, weighted contribution, and status emoji
format.top_recommendation: Single most impactful action to improve score
